objects.name: Meta APT-C-27 network disruption (October 2021)
objects.description: APT-C-27: Meta disrupted SEA/APT-C-27 accounts and infrastructure linked to Syrian Air Force Intelligence. The actor used credential phishing and trojanized Android applications.
